scope: Read-only review of output paths and RSS monitor lifecycle

findings.issue: SIGUSR1 can interrupt terminate_group during exception cleanup before SIGKILL/reap. cleanup_exception is recorded without completing termination, allowing a detached stage to survive supervisor exit.
findings.trigger: Timeout/error followed by RSS exceeding the limit while the child saves partial tensors after TERM.
findings.fix: Latch monitor failure and prevent resource signals from interrupting cleanup; guarantee group kill/reap in a finally path.

findings.issue: Monitor startup occurs before the protected try, and monitor shutdown occurs inside an unprotected finally. An early or pending SIGUSR1 can bypass final result persistence.
findings.fix: Protect monitor startup and disarm or safely handle pending resource signals during shutdown.
